summary: San Francisco Bay Area, software developer with a focus on full-stack development, holds a Master's in Information Systems (MIS) with a background in Computer Science, strong advocate for coding best practices and software architecture principles, critical of Agile methodologies and corporate bureaucracy, passionate about programming languages and software design, has a daughter, enjoys pool and technology discussions, skeptical of offshoring and H1B visa practices, believes in the importance of ethical business practices and labor rights, critical of the drug war and its societal impacts, values personal freedom and privacy, interested in historical and political discussions, has a strong opinion on the impact of technology on society and the economy.
